resources.string: Stop And Breathe is an open-source app that interrupts mindless scrolling with a short breathing break. Every %1$d minutes of screen-on, unlocked time, it displays a reminder that you can dismiss after %2$d seconds.
Stop And Breathe is an open-source app that interrupts mindless scrolling with a short breathing break.
Anyone can inspect the source code. Open source does not mean the app has been independently audited.
Screen-content retrieval is disabled. The service declares canRetrieveWindowContent=\"false\" and is not granted that capability.

Android doesn't have much narrow permissions for accessbility services, so it asks for more permissions than the app is actually configured to use. This app is configured to:

 1. Display blocking reminders over ordinary apps.

 2. Receive window-change metadata to recognize apps being used that should be excluded from accumulated screen time.

 Screen-content retrieval is disabled!

App detection uses only package and class metadata from window changes. Screen text, routes and locations are not read. No app history is stored or transmitted. No location or internet permission is requested.
Blocking is best-effort. System controls, emergency screens and notifications may remain available.

Reminders start automatically once access is enabled, including after reboot and unlock. To stop them, turn off the service in Android accessibility settings.
This is an early version. Coming features will be listed here.

1. Tap “Open settings” below.

 2. Find Stop And Breathe, usually under “Installed apps” or “Downloaded apps”.

 3. Turn on the service and review Android’s confirmation. This allows reminders to block ordinary touches until their countdown ends.

 4. Return here to check that reminders are active.

 Settings names vary by device. You can turn off the same service at any time to stop reminders.

Displays full-screen mindful-breathing reminders and blocks ordinary touches until the countdown finishes. Reminders start automatically, including after reboot. Detects active map apps from app/window package names so they count as idle and remain unobstructed. Screen-content access is disabled. Does not read screen text, routes or locations, or store or transmit app history. Time off, locked or in maps restores the interval. A started reminder continues while off or in maps, but pauses on the lit lock screen. System controls may remain available.
